title: WPA3-SAE / WPA2+WPA3 / WPA2-hardened AP profiles - key-setup ladder (design only, NOT FIRED by this lane)

base.chain: opensource 008aca5 FINAL all-patch module (wpa-static + beacon-static + rx-static + sta-static)

preconditions: fresh golden boot: page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, state 1, mask 0, staging 0
attended session with the recovery door READY (tools/recovery-card.sh)
PD4 firmware pushed by hand; local Wi-Fi block staged; never packaged/committed
one module load per boot; record params before the fire

module_params.common: fw_path=hi_wifi/FIRMWARE.PD4.bin wifi_block_path=<local block> allow_frames=32 frame_gap_ms=100 h2d_send_budget=10 vap_start_first=1 vap_start_mode=1 vap_start_module=0 hcc_poll_ms=5 hcc_trace=0 stop_ap_mode=0 mgmt_diag=0 rx_enable=1 beacon_static=1 beacon_vap_start=1 wpa_key_module=0 sta_join=0 ht_mode=0 vht_cap=0 band_vendor=0 scan_band_cfg=0

rungs.name: patched-module baseline (open AP control)
rungs.purpose: prove the capability patch does not change the AP-start baseline
steps: fresh golden boot; capture page/mask
insmod with the common params (wpa_keys=1)
boot ladder + C2, iface __ap, hostapd with the open fixture
record AP-ENABLED, page/mask, cfg80211_status
pass: AP-ENABLED as the project baseline
page golden, mask 0, no exception
cfg80211_status: wpa_keys=1, add_ok=0, defmgmt_ok=0

rungs.name: fail-closed proof (wpa_keys=0 + WPA3-SAE hostapd)
rungs.purpose: prove the new management-key path never writes a frame when disabled
steps: fresh golden boot; page/mask
insmod with the common params but wpa_keys=0
boot ladder + C2, iface __ap, hostapd with the WPA3-SAE fixture
capture dmesg and cfg80211_status
pass: AP-start 5-message plan posted
add_key log: 'add_key refused - wpa_keys=0 (fail-closed default; bench loads wpa_keys=1)'
hostapd reports the key-install failure (-EOPNOTSUPP) and tears the AP down cleanly
cfg80211_status: wpa_keys=0, add_ok=0, add_err=0, defmgmt_ok=0, gate_refused>=1
page golden, mask 0, no exception
fail_if: page/mask changes or an exception is reported

rungs.name: PRIMARY: WPA3-SAE AP startup GTK+IGTK key setup
rungs.purpose: clear the PMF AP-start blocker: hostapd installs GTK and IGTK and selects the default management key
steps: fresh golden boot; page/mask
insmod with the common params and wpa_keys=1 wpa_key_module=0
boot ladder + C2, iface __ap, hostapd with the WPA3-SAE fixture
watch dmesg for the 5 AP frames, GTK pair, IGTK pair, then AP-ENABLED
record cfg80211_status and hostapd liveness for >=120 s
expect_dmesg: cfg80211: start_ap beacon_static=1 plan (5 steps): vap_add ap_chan ap_ssid ap_cfg ap_vap_start
cfg80211: add_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0078 'key_add', 96 B, module=0 idx=1 pairwise=0 cipher=0x000fac04 class=data key_len=16 seq_len=0)
cfg80211: set_default_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0079 'key_default', 68 B, module=0 idx=1 uni=0 multi=1)
cfg80211: add_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0078 'key_add', 96 B, module=0 idx=4 pairwise=0 cipher=0x000fac0d class=mgmt key_len=16 seq_len=0)
cfg80211: set_default_mgmt_key posted (g0 id1 cmd 0x0079 'key_default_mgmt', 68 B, module=0 idx=4 cipher=0xd mgmt-class)
no 'Failed to set key' / 'Failed to set beacon parameters' after the key lines
pass: AP-ENABLED and hostapd alive >=120 s
exactly one data key_add (96 B idx 1) + one key_default (68 B idx 1) consumed
exactly one mgmt key_add (96 B idx 4 BIP-CMAC-256) + one key_default_mgmt (68 B idx 4) consumed
cfg80211_status: wpa_keys=1 add_ok=2 add_err=0 def_ok=1 defmgmt_ok=1 defmgmt_err=0 last_op=set_default_mgmt_key last_idx=4 last_errno=0
page 0x86807FEF golden, state 1, mask 0, staging 0, no exception
fail_if: post refused (budget/gap/phase/out[0]) -> record the exact refusal line, no retry
IGTK add_key or default-mgmt NOT posted -> record the refusal; the mgmt-class body field is then wrong
page/mask abnormal, H2D lane closed, or firmware exception -> STOP, power-cycle
hostapd still reports a key error after the default-mgmt line -> capture hostapd -dd log
optional_readback: module_ctx+0x190 recipe -> VAP user: user+0x310 = 0x04 (data cipher CCMP), user+0x311 = 1 (data key index), user+0x312 = 4 (mgmt key index), user+0x313 = 0x0d (BIP-CMAC-256)
this readback is optional evidence; never required to pass R2

rungs.name: transition profile startup (PSK+SAE, PMF optional)
rungs.purpose: same PMF startup path as R2 with ieee80211w=1; proves the transition fixture reaches the same key state
steps: repeat the R2 steps with configs/hostapd-wpa2-wpa3.conf
pass: same key sequence and cfg80211_status as R2
AP-ENABLED, hostapd alive >=120 s
page golden, mask 0

rungs.name: WPA2-hardened profile startup (PMF required)
rungs.purpose: same PMF startup path with ieee80211w=2 and no SAE; proves the hardened WPA2 fallback profile reaches the same key state
steps: repeat the R2 steps with configs/hostapd-wpa2-hardened.conf
pass: same key sequence and cfg80211_status as R2
AP-ENABLED, hostapd alive >=120 s
page golden, mask 0

rungs.name: BLOCKED: SAE/4-way client association
rungs.purpose: document the next gate honestly; do not attempt to fake it
steps: SAE authentication is host software and needs the AP management TX path (wal_cfg80211_mgmt_tx family, wifi-ap-mgmt lane) plus management RX; the SAE commit/confirm are auth frames (mgmt subtype 11)
association also needs cfg80211 .add_station/.del_station + the firmware per-STA user context; without it hostapd logs 'Could not add STA to kernel driver' and sends no assoc response
the 4-way PTK then needs EAPOL over the RX data path

rungs.name: teardown/soak observation
rungs.purpose: confirm no new leak or hot-path regression
steps: hostapd kill -> controlled stop_ap path
60-minute soak sampler (wifi-stability soak tooling) alongside the AP
if a key_del is emitted during teardown, record it (expected only for a known STA)
pass: no new dmesg noise class from the PMF key path when idle
page/mask stable across the soak; hostapd count stable

abort_policy: any page != golden or mask != 0 -> stop, capture, power-cycle (never rmmod after release)
H2D lane closed / timeout -> stop; do not retry the same frame in the same boot
no bench link / recovery door not READY -> no fire
do not attempt R5 until the mgmt TX/RX + station-op lanes are closed
